content.value: Consider a metal with FCC structure and atomic weight of 92.9. When monochromatic (08) X-radiation having a wave length of 0.1028 nm is focused on the crystal, the angle of diffraction (2θ) for the (311) set of planes in this metal occurs at 71.2 degrees for the first order reflection n = 1. Calculate –
i) the inter-planner spacing for this set of planes
ii) lattice parameters for this metal
